name: accessibility
description: Check or control accessibility services. On Android: omit talkback to check TalkBack state, or pass talkback: true/false to enable/disable it. On iOS: omit voiceover to check VoiceOver state, or pass voiceover: true/false to enable/disable it (Simulator only). Always returns fresh state from the device.

talkback.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) TalkBack on the active Android device

voiceover.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) VoiceOver on iOS Simulator

name: accessibilityFocus
description: Set or clear Android TalkBack focus by resourceId, text, or contentDesc.

action.description: set default or clear TalkBack focus

bounds.description: Element bounds. Default: object {left, top, right, bottom} (+ optional centerX/centerY). Under --observe-result-compact: positional tuple [left, top, right, bottom].

name: biometricAuth
description: Simulate biometric auth: Android emulator/SDK hook or iOS Simulator.

action.description: match/fail/cancel/error; cancel/error require Android SDK hook

modality.description: Modality: any default, fingerprint, or face

fingerprintId.description: Fingerprint ID: default 1 for match/error, 2 for fail/cancel

name: bugReport
description: Generate a comprehensive bug report for debugging AutoMobile interactions. Captures screen state, view hierarchy, logcat, window info, and screenshot. The report is saved to a file for sharing with AutoMobile developers.

appId.description: App package ID to filter logcat for specific app

logcatLines.description: Number of recent logcat lines to include (default: 1000)

name: changeLocalization
description: Change locale, time zone, text direction, time format, and calendar system

calendarSystem.description: Calendar system (e.g., gregory, japanese, buddhist, islamic-civil)

restartApp.description: iOS bundle ID to relaunch after locale change

mockId.description: Mock ID; omit to clear all

name: criticalSection
description: Synchronize multiple devices at a barrier, then run steps serially.

name: debugSearch
description: Debug element search operations. Shows all matching elements, which one would be selected, and near-misses that almost matched. Use this to understand why an element isn't being found or why the wrong element is being selected.

text.description: Text to search for in elements

elementId.description: Element resource ID / accessibility identifier to search for

container.description: Container element to scope the search - specify elementId or text to locate it

partialMatch.description: Whether to use partial matching (substring containment, default: true)

caseSensitive.description: Whether to use case-sensitive matching (default: false)

includeNearMisses.description: Include elements that almost matched (default: true)

maxNearMisses.description: Maximum number of near-misses to include (default: 10)

strictBackupMode.description: Fail if app data backup fails

userApps.description: Apps to back up: current or all

appBundleIds.description: iOS bundle IDs for app data snapshot

name: executePlan
description: Execute YAML plan steps; stops on first failed step.

name: explore
description: Automatically explore app to build navigation graph

name: exportPlan
description: Stop active recording and export a YAML plan.

permissions.description: Optional permissions or simulator privacy services to query

name: getDeviceState
description: Read device-level state such as Do Not Disturb

include.description: State fields to read; supports doNotDisturb

name: getPreference
description: Read an Android system property, Android SharedPreferences key, or iOS UserDefaults key.

suite.description: SharedPreferences file name or UserDefaults suite/app group

key.description: Preference key or Android system property name

name: highlight
description: Draw a visual highlight around a UI element.

selectionStrategy.description: Selection strategy when multiple match (default: first)

name: inputText
description: Input text. The optional mode field is Android-only and ignored on iOS.

mode.description: Android text mode: a11y default; eventLast helps autocomplete; eventAll sends key events

name: keyboard
description: Open, close, or detect the on-screen keyboard

clearAppData.description: Clear app data before launch (default false)

name: listApps
description: Guide for listing apps via MCP resources

name: navigateTo
description: Navigate to screen using navigation graph

name: network
description: Control network capture and error simulation.

waitFor.description: Wait for element to appear before returning observation

textAny.description: Ordered text variants; first visible match wins

skipBackStack.description: Skip back stack during waitFor polling

name: phoneCall
description: Simulate Android emulator phone call via gsm commands.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number; required except for hold

rotationDegrees.description: Degrees the two-finger axis rotates during the pinch (default: 0). The axis starts horizontal and ends rotated by this amount — a combined pinch+rotate, not a pinch along a fixed rotated axis. Same convention on Android and iOS.

includeSystemInsets.description: Use full screen including status/nav bars

name: postNotification
description: Post notification via Android SDK hooks or iOS Simulator simctl push.

channelId.description: Android channel ID / iOS APNs category

appId.description: Android target package name or iOS target bundle ID

name: putAppFile
description: Write file/text/base64 content into an app container.

name: recordSteps
description: Record MCP tool calls to YAML. begin/end require mcp-recording; status always works.

name: selectAllText
description: Select all text in focused input

name: sendSms
description: Send simulated incoming SMS on Android emulator.

message.description: SMS body; max 1024 chars, no newlines/NUL

name: setAppPermissions
description: Grant, revoke, reset, or configure app permissions on Android devices, iOS simulators (grant/revoke/reset), and iOS physical devices (reset only, permissions=['all'] supported)

action.description: Permission action; defaults to grant. Android supports grant; iOS simulators support grant/revoke/reset; iOS physical devices support reset only, including permissions=['all'].

permissions.description: Runtime permissions or simulator privacy services to change; iOS physical reset accepts 'all'

name: setDeviceState
description: Set device state such as Do Not Disturb.

doNotDisturb.description: Do Not Disturb state to apply.

enabled.description: Enable or disable Do Not Disturb

name: setPreference
description: Write an Android system property, Android SharedPreferences key, or iOS UserDefaults key and return read-back verification.

suite.description: SharedPreferences file name or UserDefaults suite/app group

key.description: Preference key or Android system property name

type.description: Value type for typed preference stores

name: setUIState
description: Set multiple form fields by desired state.

name: sqlQuery
description: Execute SQL on app SQLite database.

name: startTestRecording
description: Start recording user interactions for exportPlan.

includeSystemInsets.description: Use full screen including status/nav bars

gestureType.description: Finger direction or content scroll direction; default: scrollTowardsDirection

lookFor.description: Element to look for during swipe

elementId.description: ID of the element to look for

boomerang.description: Return to start position after swipe apex

apexPause.description: Pause duration at swipe apex in ms (0-3000)

tapActionLabel.description: Action button label to tap (for 'tap' action)

awaitTimeout.description: Timeout in ms to wait for notification (default: 5000)

name: tapAny
description: Tap any clickable element; scope with container or scrollableContainer.

searchUntil.description: Poll for clickable element before tapping

name: tapOn
description: Tap an element by text/content-desc or resource-id; use sibling for adjacent controls.

textAny.description: Ordered text variants; first visible match wins

selector.description: Element to tap: elementId, text, or ordered text variants

sibling.description: Tap a clickable sibling of the match, e.g. checkbox beside label

selectionStrategy.description: Selection strategy when multiple match (default: first)

preTapStability.description: Require stable bounds before tapping; use for dynamic UI

retryIfNoChange.description: Retry once if the view hierarchy is unchanged after tap
